## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (existing behaviour changes)
- [ ] Refactor or cleanup (no functional change)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Build, CI, or tooling
